metadata.title: 波の周期表——巻き数番地と観測時計による粒子分類の仮説 / The Periodic Table of Waves: A Hypothesis for Particle Classification by Winding Addresses and Observation Clocks
metadata.description: A hypothesis-proposal paper: particle species are classified not as fixed attributes of waves but by how an observation clock reads winding states — decomposing charge, confinement, statistics, mass, and lifetime into (state-side address) x (observation clock) x (relation to the sea). Built purely from measurements on two published anonymous wave dynamics: universal clock omega=pi/72 (N=4-144, 0.1%), charge rule Q_em=m/3 with confinement = mod-3 readability (isolated quark-type windings remain exactly unreadable; hadronization restores integer charge), statistics = Z2 clock double cover (phase quantized to {0,pi}), mass as a relation to the sea (divisor-class theorem), and a native periodic table with a 62-species Standard-Model assignment (confidence-tagged). Includes 13 recorded refutations, 5 falsification conditions, and the requirement specification for a unifying universal interaction function. 仮説提案論文。粒子種を波の固定属性ではなく「状態側の番地×観測時計×海との関係」で分類する。普遍時計ω=π/72、電荷則Q_em=m/3と閉じ込め=mod3可読性、統計=Z₂時計被覆、質量=海との関係量、原始周期表と標準模型62種割当案(確度記号付き)。反証13件・反証条件5件・万能相互作用関数への要件仕様を含む。

title: 波の周期表——巻き数番地と観測時計による粒子分類の仮説 / The Periodic Table of Waves: A Hypothesis for Particle Classification by Winding Addresses and Observation Clocks
